description: Returns one brand's report for last month (or the month given): what was published on each network, the numbers each network returned, clicks on tracked links and approvals, and client_link: the client's private page opened on its Last month tab, when the brand has an active client link. Pro and above brand it for the client; on Free and Starter it is a preview under PostWire's mark and its note names the plan that includes client reports.

brand_id.description: The client's brand. Omit it and give brand_name instead.

month.description: The month, e.g. 2026-09. Default last month.

name: client_report
title: Get a client's monthly report
